description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across six medical specialties. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Per-specialty terms," displays six groups in the following order: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical value axis, labeled "Negative log probability," uses a linear scale ranging from -22 at the top to -27 at the bottom, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1 unit; consequently, the bars extend downwards from the -22 baseline. Each category on the horizontal axis contains a group of seven bars. According to the legends at the top, the first bar in each group is light blue, representing "Mistralv0.2-Base." This is followed by six bars representing different specialties, color-coded in a gradient from light to dark: Cardio (lightest beige), Gastro (light beige), Infect (light orange), Neuro (orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Across all groups, the light blue Mistralv0.2-Base bar consistently extends the furthest down, indicating the most negative log probability values, reaching its lowest point in the Cardio group at approximately -26.8. The six specialty-specific bars within each group are shorter (less negative) than the Mistralv0.2-Base bar. The shortest bars overall (closest to the -22 baseline) are found in the Infect group, where the specialty bars range from approximately -23.0 to -23.2. In contrast, the specialty bars in the Cardio group extend further down, ranging from roughly -25.7 to -26.1. The groups on the horizontal axis and the bars within each group follow a fixed categorical order rather than being sorted by value, and there are no visually emphasized bars beyond the distinct color coding defined in the legends.
